# BiXBiT

> BiXBiT is an industrial Bitcoin mining infrastructure provider. It develops custom firmware for Antminer (Bitmain) and Whatsminer (MicroBT) ASIC miners, the BiXBiT AMS remote monitoring and management platform for ASIC fleets, immersion and hydro cooling systems for mining farms and data centers, and smart PDUs for power monitoring. BiXBiT serves mining farm operators, hosting providers, data center engineering teams and institutional miners.

Key facts:

- BiXBiT firmware is free to download and has a transparent dev fee that is automatically deducted from the device's hashrate during operation: 2.8% standard, 2% for Whatsminer M2x [VERIFY: current rate with the team]. Hosting providers and large fleets can request partner terms (reduced dev fee, white-label interface, bulk remote installation) through the enterprise offer on the firmware pages.
- The current list of supported Antminer and Whatsminer models, firmware versions and fee per series is maintained on https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares. Treat that page as the source of truth for compatibility.
- BiXBiT AMS is included free of charge with BiXBiT firmware; AMS HUB can also connect devices running factory or third-party firmware [VERIFY: current AMS pricing with the team].
- BiXBiT and PiTBiT are different companies. Dev fee figures published for other firmware vendors do not apply to BiXBiT firmware.
- Official website: https://bixbit.io (English at /en, Russian at /ru, Spanish at /es). Product documentation: https://docs.bixbit.io.

## Firmware

- [BiXBiT custom ASIC firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares): Hub for BiXBiT firmware for Antminer and Whatsminer: supported series and models, current versions, dev fee per series, enterprise offer and FAQ.
- [Antminer firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/antminer): BiXBiT custom firmware for Bitmain Antminer miners: tuning features (overclocking, undervolting, profiles), pricing, trial and partnership terms.
- [Whatsminer firmware, all series](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/whatsminer-all-series): Overview of BiXBiT alternative firmware for MicroBT Whatsminer M2x, M3x, M5x and M6x series.
- [Whatsminer M3x firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/whatsminer-series-m3x): BiXBiT firmware for Whatsminer M30, M31 and M32 series miners: features, download and installation steps.
- [Whatsminer M5x firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/whatsminer-series-m5x): BiXBiT firmware for Whatsminer M5x series miners: features, download and installation steps.
- [Whatsminer M6x firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/whatsminer-series-m6x): BiXBiT firmware for Whatsminer M6x series miners: features, download and installation steps.
- [Whatsminer M2x firmware](https://bixbit.io/en/firmwares/whatsminer-series-m2x): BiXBiT firmware for Whatsminer M20S and M21S series miners: features, download and installation steps.

## Monitoring (AMS)

- [BiXBiT AMS: ASIC monitoring software](https://bixbit.io/en/ams): Cloud service for remote monitoring and management of ASIC mining fleets: real-time device data, remote control, email and Telegram notifications, FAQ.
- [Connecting devices to AMS](https://docs.bixbit.io/ams/connecting_a_device.html): Documentation on how to connect an ASIC miner to BiXBiT AMS.

## Cooling

- [ASIC cooling solutions](https://bixbit.io/en/asics-cooling): Overview of BiXBiT cooling systems for ASIC miners: immersion and hydro cooling for high-density deployments.
- [Immersion cooling systems](https://bixbit.io/en/asics-cooling/immersion-systems): BiXBiT immersion cooling for Bitcoin mining: how the systems work, deployment and the product range.
- [Hydro cooling systems](https://bixbit.io/en/asics-cooling/hydro-systems): BiXBiT hydro (liquid) cooling for Antminer and Whatsminer miners, including waste-heat reuse.
- [Immersion cooling products](https://bixbit.io/en/products): Catalog of BiXBiT immersion cooling hardware: cells, racks, containers and dielectric coolant.
- [BiXBiT Container](https://bixbit.io/en/products/container): Mining container with BiXBiT cooling in 20-ft and 40-ft shipping-container formats, with optional heat recovery.
- [BiXBiT Immersion Container, single-loop](https://bixbit.io/en/products/container-1k): Single-loop immersion mining container for moderate climates.
- [BiXBiT Hydro Container](https://bixbit.io/en/products/container-hydro): Hydro-cooled mining container built on BiXBiT Hydro Racks for Whatsminer hydro miners.
- [BiXBiT Rack](https://bixbit.io/en/products/rack): Stackable immersion cooling rack for ASIC miners.
- [BiXBiT Hydro Rack](https://bixbit.io/en/products/rack-hydro): Hydro cooling rack for ASIC miners with integrated cooling management.
- [BiXBiT Cell](https://bixbit.io/en/products/cell): Compact immersion cooling tank for small ASIC deployments.
- [BiXBiT Coolant](https://bixbit.io/en/products/coolant): Dielectric immersion cooling fluid for ASIC miners.
- [Server and data center cooling](https://bixbit.io/en/products/server): BiXBiT immersion cooling for servers and prefabricated data centers.

## Power distribution

- [BiXBiT Smart PDU](https://bixbit.io/en/products/pdu): Managed PDU for mining farms and data centers: real-time power monitoring, load optimization and AMS integration.

## Documentation

- [Installing and updating BiXBiT firmware on Antminer](https://docs.bixbit.io/installing_and_updating_bixbit_firmware/antminer.html): Step-by-step guide to installing and updating BiXBiT firmware on Antminer devices.
- [Installing and updating BiXBiT firmware on Whatsminer](https://docs.bixbit.io/installing_and_updating_bixbit_firmware/whatsminer.html): Step-by-step guide to installing and updating BiXBiT firmware on Whatsminer devices.
- [Factory firmware installation and rollback](https://docs.bixbit.io/additional_instructions/factory_firmware_installation_and_rollback.html): How to return an ASIC miner to stock manufacturer firmware.
- [ASIC overclocking and related functions](https://docs.bixbit.io/additional_instructions/asic_overclock.html): How overclocking and related tuning functions work in BiXBiT firmware.
- [Preparing an ASIC miner for immersion cooling](https://docs.bixbit.io/additional_instructions/preparation_for_immersion_cooling.html): Steps to prepare an ASIC miner before placing it in an immersion cooling system.
- [BiXBiT firmware features](https://docs.bixbit.io/functionality_of_the_bixbit_firmware/index.html): Reference for the BiXBiT firmware interface on Antminer and Whatsminer.
- [Documentation hub](https://bixbit.io/en/documentation): User guides and error codes for Whatsminer ASIC miners on bixbit.io.
- [Whatsminer user manual](https://bixbit.io/en/documentation/new-user-guide-for-whatsminer-asic): Whatsminer setup guide: technical requirements, setup steps, firmware basics, pool and worker configuration.
- [Whatsminer error codes and solutions](https://bixbit.io/en/documentation/error-codes-for-whatsminer-asic/list-of-errors-and-solutions-1): Whatsminer error codes with troubleshooting steps for fan, power supply and hashboard issues.
- [FAQ](https://bixbit.io/en/faq): Answers about BiXBiT immersion cooling systems, firmware and AMS.
